title: Urugendo rw'ubugingo bwakiriwe
intro: Mu gihe amahame mbonezamubano yari akomeye, umuntu udasanzwe yahuye n'impinduka zikomeye mu rugo rw'umugisha. Inkuru yabo, yarangwaga n'umurunga w'urukundo n'itegeko ry'Imana, igaragaza gusenyuka kw'imigenzo ya kera no gushyiraho amahame mashya kandi akiranuka. Iyi nkuru igaragaza akamaro k'ukuri kuruta imigenzo n'ubwenge buri inyuma y'amategeko ya Allah.
clues: Nari imbohe, ariko binyuze mu gahunda y'Imana, nabonye inzu nshya n'umuryango mushya.
Nakundwaga cyane ku buryo igihe nahabwaga amahitamo hagati y'umuryango wanjye w'ababyeyi n'uwandeze, nahisemo kugumana n'uwo wa kabiri.
Izina ryanjye ryari risanzwe rikoreshwa ku muntu wari undeze, ikintu cyari gisanzwe mu muryango wanjye.
Ni njye wenyine mugenzi w'Intumwa ya nyuma Allah yavuze izina rye muri Korowani mu buryo bweruye.
Nashakanye n'umugore w'umunyacyubahiro wari mubyara w'Intumwa, ariko ishyingiranwa ryacu ntiryaramba.
Nyuma yo gutandukana kwanjye, Allah ubwe yategetse ko uwahoze ari umugore wanjye azashyingiranwa n'Intumwa, bityo akuraho umuco wa kera wo kurera abana.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
